ocr.notes: Matches the image, including the headline.

title.suggested: Great Fight for $10,000 and the World's Title

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Star advertised that next Sunday's paper would carry Prof. Bill Clark's story, told to Billy Murphy, of the Tom Allen and Jem Mace fight for $10,000 and the world's title in New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Thursday, The St. Louis Star, January 25, 1912', page 4; the box is in the second column. Same advertisement as 225 and 226.

notes: A promotional box for the Star's 'Great Stories of the Ring' No. 4 by Prof. Bill Clark. It names Allen as the winner; Jem Mace won the 1870 fight, so no fight facts are taken from it. Repeat of the ad in 225; the current title 'Jem Mace fight' is vague.
